title: Better Fabric
description: Better optimized Minecraft modpack for Fabric.
body:
# Better Fabric modpack
This mod pack improves your game performance and enhances your visuals. It diversifies mob animations. Reduces system fatigue caused by unnecessary processes and optimizes your game.

## Some included mods:
- Sodium
- Iris Shaders
- Entity Culling
- FerriteCore
- Lithium
- ImmediatelyFast
- Memory Leak Fix
- LazyDFU
- c2me
- e4mc

## Some Resource Packs:
- Fresh Animations
- Fresh Moves
- Recolorful Containers
- Qrafty's Capitalized Font
